utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli — I’m in for book club. What’s the next read?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nice, thanks Leo. I’ll let you know the next book as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just ping me when it’s set. I’m happy to bring snacks too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should keep the book club simple at first—maybe one short book and a clear meeting time so everyone can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds sensible—can you confirm which book and what meeting time you’re thinking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m leaning toward a short mystery and maybe the second Thursday evening, but I’d want to check what works for everyone before we settle it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club — right, I’m in. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I knew I’d forget the title. Let me check and I’ll get back to you in a sec.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries, just ping me when you find it. I’ll bring a notebook so I don’t miss it again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we keep it simple for book club this time—pick one book, set a date, and send everyone the details. If you want, I can help repeat the plan to the others.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good to me—simple is better. I can help spread the word when you have the date.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll pick a date and send out the details, then you can help repeat it to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we were just getting started. The pick is `Project Hail Mary`.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I’m in. What’s the first meeting date?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me, Quinn—what’s the plan for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m thinking we keep it cozy at my place this Thursday—bring your copy and I’ll make tea and snacks. I’ll text the rest of the neighbors so everyone’s in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds perfect, Quinn. I’ll bring my copy and be there Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, still on for this week — I’m looking forward to it. What time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — how about Thursday at 7?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal — are we still on for book club this week? I’d love to hear what everyone thinks of the book.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — we’re still on for book club this week. I’ll check the location and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks! Just send me the place when you know it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m glad we’re talking book club. What are you thinking for our next read?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara — I’d love something engaging but easy to discuss. Maybe a short novel or a memoir with strong themes?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect — I’m thinking a short novel with a lot to talk about, maybe something warm but layered. Want me to bring a couple of options and we can choose together?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got snacks and tea ready for book club—want me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nope, that’s perfect — I’ll just bring myself and the book.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, see you there — I’m excited to hear what you think of the book.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard this month’s pick is supposed to be really good—want me to ask around and see if anyone knows the title yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, thanks. I’d like to know the title before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the title. If I catch it first, I’ll send it your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m glad to help—what detail about the book club should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you check the meeting time and whether they changed the pickup plan after school?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check both: the meeting time and whether the pickup plan changed after school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira — I’m in for book club, just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll text you the details as soon as I’ve got them. Should be a nice low-key one this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for your text. Low-key is exactly what I need this week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the book club and let everyone know the plan. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. See you at book club!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the plan and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the book club. I think I saw something about the next meeting, but I might’ve missed the details. What’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure either — I’ve been a bit out of it lately. I can check the notice and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help — I probably glanced at it and forgot already. Let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what the book club’s reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the list and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d love to help with the book club—shall we pick a book and set a date for our next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll pick a book and look for a good date for our next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — once you’ve got a title and date, I can help spread the word and gather a few RSVP’s.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but could we sort out the time and place first? I’d like to make sure I can actually get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — how about Thursday at 7 at my place on Maple Street? If that’s tricky, I’m happy to pick somewhere closer for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at 7 works if Maple Street isn’t too far, but I’d feel better with something a bit closer if that’s possible.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, we’re still doing the book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, let me check the details first, but I think we’re still on for this week.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the day and time once you’ve checked?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what book are we picking, and when do we meet?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m good with either a short novel or something funny, and I can do next Thursday evening if that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Let’s pick something short and funny, and meet next Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting went well—did they end up picking the next book?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, they did—someone brought a good shortlist, and they finally picked the next one. I can tell you which book it is if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh yes, please—what did they pick?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—book club. I’m pretty sure I said I’d bring something, unless I’m mixing it up with the bake sale again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could be the bake sale, but for book club we still need a snack list—want me to bring some tea and crackers?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tea and crackers would be great, Mara—thank you. I’ll bring something sweet, assuming I don’t accidentally show up with casserole again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school pickup time, so the book club should be doable. What day were you thinking, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday evening works best for me—say 7?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 works for me too. I’ll plan around pickup and be there.
